mapper.select: SELECT d.id, u.name, u.sex, u.phone_num, u.email, d.doc_title_id, d.depart_id, d.status FROM doctor d JOIN "user" u ON d.id = u.id
SELECT id, name, gender, birth_date, phone, address FROM patient

SELECT rr.patient_ID, rr.sch_ID, rr.register_time, rr.status FROM register_record rr
AND rr.patient_ID = #{patientId}
AND rr.register_time >= to_timestamp(#{begin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND rr.register_time <= to_timestamp(#{end}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT dsr.id, dsr.doc_id, dsr.schedule_date, dsr.left_source_count, dsr.status FROM doc_schedule_record dsr
AND dsr.doc_id = #{doctorId}
AND dsr.schedule_date >= to_date(#{begin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND dsr.schedule_date <= to_date(#{end}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
